identity.original_title: The Shimmering Horizon and Cursed Blacksmith

hooks.text: 每移动一步敌人紧随行动，侵蚀值形成生存倒计时
hooks.excerpt: Think carefully before you move in this turn-based battle system where enemies move right after you. Be aware of the Erosion. You won't last long when it reaches its limit.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 材料现场锻造百种武器，碎武继承力量
hooks.excerpt: Create different weapons based on the materials you choose. Each and every weapon possesses an unique Skill, broaden your playstyle. Make shattered weapons materials as well, inheriting their strength to the next masterpiece.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 通过记忆揭开世界真相的15万字全配音叙事
hooks.excerpt: Find Memories to reach out to the truth of "this world." Storytelling via both cutscenes and text-based novels with over 150K word count. All 6 main characters and elite enemies are fully voiced by Japanese voice actresses, with real-time 2D animations.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
